title: Client Health Score, built with brainfreeze studio
summary: The Client Health Score workshop's clean entity tables on SharePoint, with a managed app. Unlisted records, rules and calculations remain in retained knowledge. Easy and Manual use the same listed fields and do not fabricate missing records.

easy.title: Easy mode: brainfreeze studio builds it

steps.title: Get the tools and sign in once
steps.action: Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.
steps.expected: The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

steps.title: Build and deploy everything with one command
steps.action: Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.
steps.expected: It prints the 2 lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

steps.title: See the synthetic records in SharePoint
steps.action: Open the site and the Client Health Score Stakeholder Records list.
steps.expected: 3 fictional records, including TechCorp Industries (StakeholderRecordId TechCorp Industries), with ID CL-301.

steps.title: Open the Draft agent in Copilot Studio
steps.action: Open Client Health Score Studio and review its inventory.
steps.expected: The studio instructions, 5 skills, 2 rules knowledge file(s) and 2 SharePoint Get items tools; no web search; Draft, not published.

steps.title: Test: Client Success Leader
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Which relationships are healthy, at risk, or critical, and where should my team focus first?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: TechCorp Industries; Churn Indicator; CRITICAL. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Account Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: What engagement signals are weakening across the portfolio, especially executive contact and escalations?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: No executive contact in 90 days; Declining billing trend; TechCorp Industries. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Client Experience Director
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Which client satisfaction trends are moving the wrong way, and what evidence supports that view?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Declining Accounts Requiring Attention; TechCorp Industries; Global Finance Corp. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Client Success Leader
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Give me the accounts that need intervention now, the risk drivers, and the first recovery actions.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: TechCorp Industries; Global Finance Corp; Healthcare Solutions Inc. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Account Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Build the stakeholder map and executive engagement plan for each account that needs a turnaround.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Morgan Lee; Value realization workshop; Approval gate. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Open the managed app
steps.action: Open the play link brainfreeze studio printed, and allow the app to use your SharePoint connection the first time.
steps.expected: Client Health Score: 2 read-only tabs from the same lists. 3 fictional records, including TechCorp Industries (StakeholderRecordId TechCorp Industries), with ID CL-301.

steps.title: Open a SharePoint site for the workshop data
steps.action: Use a SharePoint site you can edit, or create one (SharePoint start page, Create site, Communication site) named AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual.
steps.expected: The site's home page opens and you can create lists on it.

steps.title: Create Client Health Score Stakeholder Records from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload stakeholder-records.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set StakeholderRecordId, ID, ExecutiveSponsor, AccountOwner, DeliveryLead, NextEngagement to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Name the list Client Health Score Stakeholder Records. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 3 fictional records, including TechCorp Industries (StakeholderRecordId TechCorp Industries), with ID CL-301.

steps.title: Create Client Health Score Client Records from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload client-records.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set ClientRecordId, Health, NPS, Billing, Escalations90D, ExecMeetings90D, Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, Segment to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep AnnualValue, Margin, Utilization as Number. Name the list Client Health Score Client Records. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 8 fictional records, including TechCorp Industries (ClientRecordId CL-301), with AnnualValue 2400000.

steps.title: Create a blank agent
steps.action: In Copilot Studio, create a new agent and skip the description flow.
steps.expected: A new, empty agent opens on its Build page.

steps.title: Name the agent
steps.action: Rename it Client Health Score Manual. (Agent names can be at most 30 characters.)
steps.expected: The name shows at the top of the Build page.

steps.title: Paste the studio instructions
steps.action: Copy the whole instructions file and paste it into Instructions, replacing anything there. Then, in the last section (SharePoint site), replace YOUR_SITE_ADDRESS with your site's address, for example https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/AIBASTSyntheticDataManual. The list tools need it: Copilot Studio still asks the model for the site and list on every call.
steps.expected: The instructions start with Client Health Score Agent — Studio Global Instructions, name the two list tools, and end with your site's address.

steps.title: Save, and check the instructions stayed
steps.action: Save, go back to the agents list, and reopen the agent.
steps.expected: The same instructions are there after reopening.

steps.title: Remove web search
steps.action: In Knowledge, remove Search all websites.
steps.expected: No web search knowledge remains.

steps.title: Add the rules-and-controls knowledge
steps.action: Knowledge, Add, upload aibast_client-health-retention-playbook.md, aibast_client-health-synthetic-portfolio.md, and wait until ready. These generated files retain unlisted records and rules; the listed entity fields come from the list tools. Do not replace them with the original unfiltered knowledge files.
steps.expected: 2 rules knowledge file(s) listed as ready.

steps.title: Add the stakeholder records tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Client Health Score Stakeholder Records; name the tool Get stakeholder record records.
steps.expected: Get stakeholder record records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the client records tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Client Health Score Client Records; name the tool Get client record records.
steps.expected: Get client record records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the 5 skills
steps.action: Skills, Add, and upload each studio SKILL.md from the downloads.
steps.expected: 5 skills listed, with their frontmatter names.

steps.title: Review the agent
steps.action: Check the model, 5 skills, the rules knowledge and 2 tools.
steps.expected: Sonnet 4.6, 5 skills, 2 knowledge file(s), 2 Get items tools, no web search, nothing else.

steps.title: Confirm the agent is a Draft
steps.action: Check the agent's status; do not publish.
steps.expected: Draft; Publish was never selected.

steps.title: Get the app's source and set your site
steps.action: Generate the workshop's app folder, and set site in its src/config.ts to your SharePoint site.
steps.expected: client-health-score-app/managed-app holds a React + Vite managed app whose config names your site and the 2 lists.

steps.title: Register the app and connect the lists
steps.action: In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.
commands: ms app init --display-name "Client Health Score Workspace Manual" --repo native
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Client Health Score Stakeholder Records" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Client Health Score Client Records" --use-sso
steps.expected: ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the 2 tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

steps.title: Build, push and deploy
steps.action: Build it, commit it, push it to the app's repository and deploy it.
commands: git add -A && git commit -m "Client Health Score Workspace"
steps.expected: ms app deploy prints the app's play link.

steps.title: Open the app and compare it with the agent
steps.action: Open the play link, allow the SharePoint connection the first time, and open the Client Health Score Stakeholder Records tab.
steps.expected: The app and the agent read the same synthetic records. 3 fictional records, including TechCorp Industries (StakeholderRecordId TechCorp Industries), with ID CL-301.
